technical_explanation.approved_sources: Collectors may fetch only active machine-registry entries within their canonical boundaries; Rubric remains inactive and StarRez remains link-only.
technical_explanation.stable_ids: record_id and entity_id identify the logical source entity and do not change merely because source wording changes.
technical_explanation.content_hash: SHA-256 of canonical normalized content; the same hash means no logical content change and a different hash means CHANGED without changing identity.
technical_explanation.idempotency: Rerunning the same record compares record_id and content_hash, yielding UNCHANGED rather than a duplicate or re-embedding signal.
technical_explanation.last_known_good: Fetch, parse, validation and suspicious-zero failures record failure state but do not replace or delete the current approved record set.
